Flu vaccinations available in community

Oct 16, 2026

During the month of October, Lee Health Ambulatory Pharmacists will be available at multiple locations throughout Lee County to administer influenza vaccinations.

The remaining dates are as follows:

• Saturday, Oct. 17, from 2 to 4 p.m. at the Cape Coral Bootstrap Homeless Ministry inside the Messiah Lutheran Church, 2691 N.E. Pine Island Road, Cape Coral

• Saturday, Oct. 24, from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. at the Cape Coral Hospital Auxiliary’s Car Show & Health Fair, 609 S.E. 13th Court, Cape Coral

• Tuesday, Oct. 27, from 12:30 to 3 p.m. at the Lake Kennedy Senior Center, 400 Santa Barbara Blvd. S., Cape Coral

• Thursday, Oct. 29, from 10:30 a.m. to 12:30 p.m. at the East United Way Resiliency Hub, 4040 Palm Beach Blvd., Suite C, Fort Myers

You should bring your insurance card to receive the vaccination.

For those without insurance, the influenza vaccinations will be provided at no cost.

In addition to administering vaccinations, pharmacists and physicians will be available for consultations, while staff can assist with finding a primary care physician and providing educational information to help address individual health needs.
